description: Check a design before you show it to anybody — one call instead of validate, view and an accessibility pass. Runs `schema` (document shape), `catalog` (the pinned catalog's validation, the mutation reducer and the Compose export gate — what ui_builder_validate runs) and `a11y`: controls with no label, icons and pictures with no `contentDescription`, touch targets under 48dp, text and icon contrast under WCAG 4.5:1 / 3:1, and text in a fixed height that clips at 200% font scale. Check a stored design (`designId`, optionally a past `revision`), a whole `document`, or `operations` applied to a scratch copy of `designId` exactly as ui_builder_apply would — nothing is saved. Returns `summary` first, then `ok`, the counts, and `findings` with the `nodeId` each is about, so you can fix them with ui_builder_apply and check again. `rendered: true` measures touch targets on a native render where the host has one (needs the ui-builder-export capability). Contrast against theme roles is resolved with the Material 3 baseline scheme and reported as a warning, never an error. `guidelines` runs only when named: a model judges the design against the Android design guides (developer.android.com) for its platform and reports each broken rule as a warning or note with its source. It uses this host's shared model key, so it runs only for the accounts the operator enabled and is reported as skipped for everyone else; with `rendered: true` the visual rules are judged on the native render too.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

baseRevision.description: The revision `operations` were written against; a stale one is a warning.

checks.description: Which checks to run. Defaults to schema, catalog, a11y; `guidelines` runs only when named.

designId.description: A stored design to check, or to check `operations` against.

document.description: A whole DesignDocumentV1 to check instead of a stored design.

operations.description: DesignMutationV1 objects to apply to a scratch copy of `designId` and check — a dry run.

rendered.description: Measure touch targets on a native render, and show it to the guidelines model. Defaults to false.

revision.description: A past revision of `designId`. Omit for the current one.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: ui_builder_check_design
